calculation_steps: From dot x=−B1 y and dot y|01=B1^T x, differentiate x_i² and y_e² and define F_i→e=2B1_ie x_i y_e.
Edge-basis sign flip B[:,e]→−B[:,e], y_e→−y_e leaves F unchanged.
For T±=a±F/2, a≥|F|/2, Q24 with signed route ±1 gives eta F/2 for any a.
Sum incidences to J_e=2 y_e(B1^T x)_e and project: M^T J=2M^T diag(y)B1^T x.
Use uniform y and identical one-edge contrast at N7/13/19 to check cancellation and equal nonzero local witness.

counterexamples_and_failures: Arbitrary symmetric activity changes T± but not Q24 under the assumed signed route; Q25 weights are not canonically fixed.
The same local contrast activates formal port at N7,13,19, so no seven-cell angle selector follows.
Closed skew support flow can be instantaneous nonzero without irreversible material damping.
Hasse edge-stock injection is not spatial bond transport or Q24 scalar c without extra mapping.
